title: Python 3.15 for WASI, on BusyBox
author: The CPython project (WASI build: Brett Cannon); BusyBox from Docker Hub
licenseName: PSF License (CPython: LICENSE in the archive), GPL 2 (BusyBox)
notes: CPython 3.15.2 built for WASI (wasm32-wasip1) by the CPython project's WASI build, a WebAssembly module run by the browser's own engine: each python3 is a process of MIRAGE-LINUX, its WASI calls answered by the kernel's system calls (src/wasi.js), beside the x86 BusyBox shell that starts it -- in pipes, on the same files. A read waits for nothing yet: python3's REPL needs input already typed, so run scripts or python3 -c.
